title: Pulse lite
description: Lightweight Fabric modpack focused on maximum FPS, minimal resource usage, and smooth gameplay for low-end and mid-range devices.
body:
# Pulse Lite
Pulse Lite is a lightweight Fabric modpack designed to deliver the highest possible FPS with minimal resource usage.
Built for low-end and mid-range devices, Pulse Lite focuses on performance, stability, and smooth gameplay by including only essential optimization mods. No unnecessary features, no bloat—just pure performance.

## Features
- ⚡ Maximum FPS optimization
- 📱 Designed for Android, PojavLauncher, and Mojo Launcher users
- 🚀 Faster loading times
- 🟢 Reduced memory usage
- 🌐 Multiplayer-friendly
- 🎮 Vanilla Minecraft experience

# Recommended Settings
Render Distance: 2–4 Chunks
Simulation Distance: 2 Chunks
Graphics: Fast
Clouds: Off
Particles: Minimal
Smooth Lighting: Off
V-Sync: Off
# Perfect For
Low-end devices
Competitive players
Survival gameplay
Multiplayer servers
Players who want maximum performance
Pulse Lite — Maximum FPS. Minimal Overhead. ⚡🟢🚀
